facts: Celsius was founded in 2017 with the mission to harness blockchain technology to provide financial freedom.
Chainalysis Reactor provides third-party verification of Celsius Network's assets based on transactions, deposits, and withdrawals since June 2018.
Celsius is partnering with Horizen Labs for Proof of Community to prove liquidity without relying on external auditors.
Celsius received 10m in funding from Tether.
Celsius offers loans starting from as little as $500 up to $20m with a 1% APR interest rate.
Celsius is available in over 100 countries around the world.
